svg.title: warps_per_cta = [2, 2]
svg.desc: Four waves form two rows and two columns of wave tiles. Each wave covers eight rows and sixteen columns of values. Every outlined pair of adjacent cells belongs to one lane. The complete workgroup tile is sixteen by thirty-two values, with two hundred fifty-six threads and five hundred twelve values. Wave three lane seventeen owns row ten columns eighteen and nineteen.
svg.text: 2 rows × 2 columns of WAVES. Each wave covers 8 × 16 values.
Outlined pairs = lanes. Thick borders = waves.
256 threads × 2 values = 512 values in this base tile
